# Basic example — mock-only

This lab supplies the complete baseline. The caller uses `module.network` with
`source = "../.."`; no earlier laboratory is required.
See the [caller](main.tf), [inputs](variables.tf), [outputs](outputs.tf), and
[module API](../../docs/module-api.md).

not zero trust. The [corrected HTTPS fixture](../../exercise/rules.tfvars.example)

or apply this example. Run root mock-only checks; never add credentials/state.

Read vnet_id, subnet_ids, nsg_id and association_ids through module.network.
Subnet and association maps preserve web/data keys.
